overview_description.description:
Equals is a spreadsheet startup aiming to challenge and replace Excel with its next-generation spreadsheet. The startup provides a spreadsheet with built-in connections to any database, versioning, and collaboration. It enables users to build any analysis with data directly from their database, whether or not they know SQL.

Equals was founded in 2021 and is based in San Francisco, California.

product.name: Equals BI Spreadsheet
product.description: A spreadsheet tool connected directly to live data sources, enabling users to analyze, query, and visualize data without limits on questions or rows.

product.name: Equals GTM Analytics Solution
product.description: An all-in-one analytics platform that syncs, cleans, and analyzes go-to-market data to provide insights on pipeline, funnel, and ARR performance.

product.name: Equals ARR Reporting
product.description: A reporting service that delivers live, accurate annual recurring revenue metrics by integrating data from billing and CRM platforms.

product.name: Equals RevOps Analytics
product.description: A tool providing real-time pipeline and funnel clarity by integrating CRM and billing data into a single analytics platform.

product.name: Equals Dashboards
product.description: Live, shareable dashboards built from spreadsheets that visualize key business metrics and support real-time collaboration.
